other_failure_modes.name: optimistic_threshold_tuning_on_oof
other_failure_modes.description: The agent optimizes the rounding thresholds on the entire out-of-fold (OOF) prediction array and then evaluates the metric on the same OOF array. This causes the reported validation score to be slightly over-optimistic because the thresholds were tuned using all validation targets simultaneously, rather than being tuned securely inside the cross-validation loop.
other_failure_modes.evidence:
global_rounder.fit(oof_preds, y)
oof_discrete_preds = global_rounder.predict(oof_preds)
final_score = compute_qwk(y, oof_discrete_preds)

summary: The agent provides a high-quality, robust solution that avoids common data leakage and modeling pitfalls. Cross-validation is implemented correctly, imputation and scaling are safely contained within the folds, and multiple strong base models are ensembled. The only minor flaw is optimizing the ordinal rounding thresholds globally on the out-of-fold predictions rather than within the cross-validation loop, leading to a slightly over-optimistic local validation score.
